{{Top|leg}}
'''External address''' was a communications system built into [[Environment suit/Legends|spacesuits]] that allowed the wearer to communicate with individuals outside the suit without the need to unsuit. [[Starship/Legends|Starships]] employed a similar system known as [[external speaker mode]].
